verdict.rationale: Kit's API documents per-broadcast stats (opens, clicks, unsubscribes and their rates), per-link click performance, batch stats across broadcasts, and account-level email stats over a 90-day window with 5-year retention. That covers the per-campaign part of the story. Nothing documents per-automation-step or per-sequence-email metrics, conversion attribution, or per-campaign trends over time. Missing for 10: per-automation/sequence-step analytics, conversion metrics per campaign, time-series reporting per campaign, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can read opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions per campaign and per automation step, over time

citations.quote: Returns delivery and engagement stats for a single broadcast: recipients, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, their corresponding rates
Returns click performance for each link in a broadcast: the link `url`, its `unique_clicks`, and its click-to-delivery and click-to-open rates.
Returns account-level email performance for the last 90 days: `sent`, `opened`, and `clicked` counts plus open, click, unsubscribe, and bounce rates
The API returns email stats for the **last 5 years (60 months)**
